handoff: Review approves: all four criteria are traced to tests that assert them, and the observe, inbox, brief and PR wiring holds. Two minor notes: the view timeline does not mark a carried approve, and the Plan's S3 remerge-diff test is unwritten.

findings.title: The view timeline shows a carried approve as a plain 'approve ready'
findings.detail:
The brief's History (receiptLine) shows 'approval carried: clean base merge', which is what AC1 asks. But receiptSummary in view/timeline.ts:43 and the step summary in view/steps.ts:192 render the carried approve as 'approve <step>', with nothing to tell it apart from a person's approval. The receipt's `who` is the machine holder, so a TUI reader can take it for their own approval. That cuts against user story 41: 'so that I can see the story was not re-approved by a person'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Show `r.carried` in receiptSummary and decisionSuffix for an approve, e.g. 'approve ready (carried: clean base merge)'.

findings.title: The plan's S3 integration row for the remerge-diff evidence has no test yet
findings.detail:
The Plan's traceability row 43 maps 'ready item, brief and PR evidence show the remerge-diff' to S3 integration, with 'item text at S1 too'. Only the S1 tests exist. I read act/git-step.ts:13-19,156: it always appends pr.body after the agent's pr.md, so the wiring holds. Still, no real-git test proves the light-path update's history reaches the receipts and from there the PR body. The handoff already lists this under Not proven yet.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Cover it in the S3 harness once slice 08's shipped light route lands, or leave it to QA.
